adaptation_measures: Coordinate field validation with MAO/AEWs before public release.

texts.bulletin: OPERATIONS ADVISORY - DEFER OPEN-AIR GRAIN DRYING - Bagabag: sun-drying of palay or corn grain should be deferred. Basis: high humidity slows drying and increases mold or grain-quality risk. ACAP calendar anchor: Oct 1-15 - Rice season 1 - Seedling. Recommended action: avoid open sun-drying; use covered temporary storage or mechanical drying where available.
texts.sms: DA OPS: Defer open-air grain drying in Bagabag. High humidity slows drying and increases mold or grain-quality risk. Check MAO guidance.
texts.lgu:
OPERATIONS ADVISORY - DEFER OPEN-AIR GRAIN DRYING - Bagabag
Operation: sun-drying of palay or corn grain
Why defer: high humidity slows drying and increases mold or grain-quality risk.
ACAP calendar: Oct 1-15 - Rice season 1 - Seedling.
LGU/MAO action: avoid open sun-drying; use covered temporary storage or mechanical drying where available; inform affected barangays and reschedule support services.
texts.facebook: Operations Advisory - Defer Open-Air Grain Drying - Bagabag: Please defer sun-drying of palay or corn grain for now. Reason: high humidity slows drying and increases mold or grain-quality risk. Current crop calendar basis: Rice season 1 - Seedling. Coordinate with your Municipal Agriculturist for the next safe field window.

adaptation_measures: Improve drainage and avoid prolonged waterlogging in low-lying fields.
Increase pest and disease scouting for fungal and bacterial disease triggers.
Use resistant varieties and integrated pest management; spray only during safe weather windows.

texts.bulletin: WET SPELL DISEASE WATCH - Bagabag: 20 consecutive wet days and high humidity may favor fungal/bacterial diseases. Increase field scouting for rice blast/sheath blight and corn fungal diseases. Spray only when rain and wind conditions are safe.
texts.sms: DA WATCH: Wet/humid days in Bagabag. Scout crops for disease; spray only in clear, low-wind weather.
texts.lgu:
DISEASE WATCH - Bagabag
Ask AEWs to intensify field scouting and report pest/disease symptoms by barangay.
texts.facebook: DISEASE WATCH - Bagabag: Wet and humid conditions. Inspect rice/corn fields and consult AEW before spraying.
